title: Norweez
tagline: The first blockchain crowdfunding ecosystem on polygon solving the climate crisis.
description:
A blockchain crowdfunding ecosystem with a governance that allows the community to directly and rapidly support climate change initiatives through:
- Democratization of investment for climate change initiatives through continuously nominating and voting by the community.
- Transparency of investment, as initiatives are held accountable by the community, who voted for them to get access to funds.
- Security through a governance voting system the donors release the funds to the initiatives once an agreement has been reached. 
- A Self-sustainable funding ecosystem for initiatives through a continuous revenue stream and community engagement mechanisms. As a subset of the features, the community members have monetization opportunities while keep helping the initiatives.
how_its_made: This project uses a combination of frontend and backchain using Ceramic ComposeDB to handle data as Campaigns and User profilers in smart contracts use Polygon with super fluid to make the experience more reliable to final user And ifps/filecoin to store things like pictures and videos
